instruction: I have a professor contact list. Please add a new column 'Country' after the 'Email' column and fill in 'Hong Kong' for all three professors from HKU.

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a 'Country' column (column G) and filling it with 'Hong Kong' for all 3 HKU professors. Verified: rows 3-5 should contain 'Hong Kong' in column G.
